title: Pervasive assert/precondition/postcondition/invariant guards across all code
description: Add systematic Design-by-Contract guards throughout the entire codebase — Rust engine, Python engine, server, and client. Every public function gets precondition checks on its inputs. Every function that mutates state gets postcondition checks on its outputs. Every struct/class with representational invariants gets validation methods called at construction and after mutation. Specific targets: (1) Rust engine: debug_assert! on every index, every unwrap replaced with expect or checked access, pre/post on GameState transitions, ComponentId arena bounds, grid dimension consistency. (2) Python engine: assert statements on function entry/exit, __post_init__ validators on all dataclasses, type narrowing assertions. (3) Server: request validation before dispatch, room state invariants after every mutation, WebSocket message schema check before processing. (4) Client: runtime type checks on server messages, DOM state consistency after renders. Goal: any programming mistake — off-by-one, wrong enum variant, stale reference, dimension mismatch — triggers an immediate loud failure with a descriptive message, never silent corruption.
